title: megascope questions-JSON
description: Data payload that drives the megascope scoping engine (assets/engine.html). One run generates only this object; it is injected into the engine's <script id="scoping-data"> block. All display text supports a tiny inline markup: **bold**, `mono`, ~accent-highlight~.

meta.description: Project identity, framing, constraints, context, and theme.

project.description: Stable slug. Keys localStorage, the export title fallback, and the download filename.

subtitle.description: Small uppercase label under the title. Default: 'Scoping & planning'.

favicon.description: One or two emoji for the header mark (and the Artifact favicon). If omitted, a generic mark is drawn.

eyebrow.description: Small mono label above the headline. Default auto-derives: 'Scoping document · N areas · M decisions'.

headline.description: Serif intro headline (a short, plain-language sentence).

legend.description: Overrides the sidebar 'How to read this' note.

steps.description: The 4-ish process steps shown under the lede. Default provided.

overallNotesTitle.description: Heading for the free-text catch-all box. Default: 'Anything else?'.

closingAsk.description: Final line appended to the copy-for-Claude export (what you want back).

constraints.description: Already-decided facts, rendered as check chips. Surfacing them here prevents re-asking.

context.description: The collapsible project-context panel. All parts optional; the panel hides itself if empty.

note.description: One framing paragraph. Supports inline markup.

cards.description: An auto-fitting card grid — e.g. stages, subsystems, personas, a domain map.

blocks.description: Additional labeled context blocks, rendered in order.

heading.description: Uppercase section label above the block.

lines.description: For 'diagram': monospace lines. ~text~ = accent highlight, **text** = bold.

theme.description: Subject-grounded personality. Usually just an accent hex; everything derives from it.

accent.description: Accent color as #RGB or #RRGGBB. Drives the whole accent family in light + dark.

neutralBias.description: Subtle temperature nudge for the neutral grounds.

sections.description: Ordered decision areas. Question.section references section.id.

id.description: Short id, shown as the nav tag (e.g. 'A', 'B'). Unique.

questions.description: Every decision, pre-set to a recommended default.

id.description: Unique id, shown on the card (e.g. 'Q1').

section.description: Must match a sections[].id. Unknown ids fall into an 'Other' section.

question.description: The decision, phrased as a short question.

why.description: One-line rationale for the recommendation and the key tradeoff. Strongly recommended.

rec.description: The recommended default, pre-selected on load. A single option key for single-select; a key or array of keys for multi-select. Every key must exist in options[].key. May be ANY option, not just the first.

multi.description: If true, options render as checkboxes (multi-select). Default false (single-select radio).

options.description: 2–5 concrete choices. Order matters (present strongest/first-considered first).

label.description: The option, in a few words.

detail.description: One line elaborating the option / its consequence.
